arxiv-2108-06539.title: Theory of ionic liquids with polarizable ions on a charged electrode
arxiv-2108-06539.creator: Yury A. Budkov, Semen V. Zavarzin, Andrei L. Kolesnikov
arxiv-2108-06539.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yury A. Budkov, Semen V. Zavarzin, Andrei L. Kolesnikov. We formulate a general mean-field theory of a flat electric double layer in ionic liquids and electrolyte solutions with ions possessing static polarizability and a permanent dipole moment on a charged electrode. We establish a new analytical expression for electric double layer differential capacitance determining it as an absolute value of the ratio of the local ionic charge density to the local electric field on an electrode surface.

arxiv-2208-04343.title: EFI: A Toolbox for Feature Importance Fusion and Interpretation in Python
arxiv-2208-04343.creator: Aayush Kumar, Jimiama M. Mase, Divish Rengasamy, Benjamin Rothwell, Mercedes Torres Torres, David A. Winkler, Grazziela P. Figueredo
arxiv-2208-04343.description: Abstract * * * First and second authors have equally contributed to the work. This paper presents an open-source Python toolbox called Ensemble Feature Importance (EFI) to provide machine learning (ML) researchers, domain experts, and decision makers with robust and accurate feature importance quantification and more reliable mechanistic interpretation of feature importance for prediction problems using fuzzy sets.

arxiv-2305-15121.title: Beyond Individual Input for Deep Anomaly Detection on Tabular Data
arxiv-2305-15121.creator: Hugo Thimonier, Fabrice Popineau, Arpad Rimmel, Bich-Liên Doân
arxiv-2305-15121.description: Abstract Anomaly detection is vital in many domains, such as finance, healthcare, and cybersecurity. In this paper, we propose a novel deep anomaly detection method for tabular data that leverages Non-Parametric Transformers (NPTs), a model initially proposed for supervised tasks, to capture both feature-feature and sample-sample dependencies.

arxiv-2306-10392.title: GlyphNet: Homoglyph domains dataset and detection using attention-based Convolutional Neural Networks
arxiv-2306-10392.creator: Akshat Gupta, Laxman Singh Tomar, Ridhima Garg
arxiv-2306-10392.description: Abstract Cyber attacks deceive machines into believing something that does not exist in the first place. However, there are some to which even humans fall prey. One such famous attack that attackers have used over the years to exploit the vulnerability of vision is known to be a Homoglyph attack.

arxiv-2310-00222.title: Source Inference Attacks: Beyond Membership Inference Attacks in Federated Learning
arxiv-2310-00222.creator: Hongsheng Hu 1 , Xuyun Zhang 2 , Zoran Salcic 1 , Lichao Sun 3 , Kim-Kwang Raymond Choo 4 , and Gillian Dobbie 1
arxiv-2310-00222.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Hongsheng Hu 1 , Xuyun Zhang 2 , Zoran Salcic 1 , Lichao Sun 3 , Kim-Kwang Raymond Choo 4 , and Gillian Dobbie 1. Federated learning (FL) is a popular approach to facilitate privacy-aware machine learning since it allows multiple clients to collaboratively train a global model without granting others access to their private data.

arxiv-2409-20197.title: UIR-LoRA: Achieving Universal Image Restoration through Multiple Low-Rank Adaptation
arxiv-2409-20197.creator: Cheng Zhang, Dong Gong, Jiumei He, Yu Zhu, Jinqiu Sun, Yanning Zhang
arxiv-2409-20197.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Cheng Zhang, Dong Gong, Jiumei He, Yu Zhu, Jinqiu Sun, Yanning Zhang. Existing unified methods typically treat multi-degradation image restoration as a multi-task learning problem. Despite performing effectively compared to single degradation restoration methods, they overlook the utilization of commonalities and specificities within multi-task restoration, thereby impeding the model’s performance. Inspired by the success of deep generative models and fine-tuning techniques, we proposed a universal image restoration framework based on multiple low-rank adapters (LoRA) from multi-domain transfer learning.

arxiv-2502-19388.title: Foundations for Deductive Verification of Continuous Probabilistic Programs Note: This document is the full version of a paper with the same title published at OOPSLA 2025.
arxiv-2502-19388.creator: Kevin Batz, Joost-Pieter Katoen, Francesca Randone, Tobias Winkler
arxiv-2502-19388.description: Abstract . We lay out novel foundations for the computer-aided verification of guaranteed bounds on expected outcomes of imperative probabilistic programs featuring (i) general loops , (ii) continuous distributions, and (iii) conditioning . To handle loops we rely on user-provided quantitative invariants , as is well established.

arxiv-2504-15993.title: Benchmarking machine learning models for predicting aerofoil performance
arxiv-2504-15993.creator: Oliver Summerell, Gerardo Aragon-Camarasa and Stephanie Ordonez Sanchez
arxiv-2504-15993.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Oliver Summerell, Gerardo Aragon-Camarasa and Stephanie Ordonez Sanchez. This paper investigates the capability of Neural Networks (NNs) as alternatives to the traditional methods to analyse the performance of aerofoils used in the wind and tidal energy industry.

arxiv-2507-19091.title: Bayesian optimization and nonlocal effects method for α \alpha decay of superheavy nuclei based on CPPM
arxiv-2507-19091.creator: Xuanpeng Xiao 1, Panpan Qi 1, Gongming Yu 1, Haitao Yang 2, Qiang Hu 3
arxiv-2507-19091.description: Abstract We have integrated nonlocal effects with the Bayesian neural network (BNN) approach to enhance the prediction accuracy of α \alpha decay half-lives. The results indicate that incorporating nonlocal effects significantly impacts half-life calculations, while the BNN method substantially improves prediction accuracy and demonstrates strong extrapolation capabilities.

arxiv-2508-20702.title: Extending flow birefringence analysis to combined extensional–shear flows via Jeffery–Hamel flow measurements
arxiv-2508-20702.creator: Miu Kobayashi, William Kai Alexander Worby, Misa Kawaguchi, Yuto Yokoyama, Sayaka Ichihara, Yoshiyuki Tagawa
arxiv-2508-20702.description: Abstract This study investigates the relationship between phase retardation and strain rates in combined extensional–shear flows using the Jeffery–Hamel flow formalism, which yields an analytical velocity solution. Flow birefringence was measured in a 1.0 wt% cellulose nanocrystal (CNC) suspension using a high-speed polarization camera.

britannica-1911-rotherham-thomas.description: Article 'Rotherham, Thomas' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 23), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. also called Thomas Scot, was born at Rotherham on the 24th of August 1423; he was educated in his native town and seems to have been connected with both the universities of Oxford and Cambridge.

pmc-10576642.title: Comprehensive microbiome causal mediation analysis using MiMed on user-friendly web interfaces
pmc-10576642.creator: Hyojung Jang, Solha Park, Hyunwook Koh
pmc-10576642.description: It is a central goal of human microbiome studies to see the roles of the microbiome as a mediator that transmits environmental, behavioral, or medical exposures to health or disease outcomes. Yet, mediation analysis is not used as much as it should be.

pmc-10694870.creator: Jay C. Horvat, Richard Y. Kim, Natasha Weaver, Christopher Augood, Alexandra C. Brown, Chantal Donovan, Pierrick Dupre, Lakshitha Gunawardhana, Jemma R. Mayall, Nicole G. Hansbro, Avril A. B. Robertson, Luke A. J. O’Neill, Matthew A. Cooper, Elizabeth G. Holliday, Philip M. Hansbro, Peter G. Gibson
pmc-10694870.description: BackgroundIncreased airway NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated IL-1β responses may underpin severe neutrophilic asthma. pmc-13030077.title: BGSE-RRT*: A Goal-Guided and Multi-Sector Sampling-Expansion Path Planning Algorithm for Complex Environments
pmc-13030077.creator: Wenhao Yue, Xiang Li, Ziyue Liu, Xiaojiang Jiang, Lanlan Pan
pmc-13030077.description: In complex ground environments, conventional RRT* often suffers from low planning efficiency and poor path quality for robot path planning. This paper proposes BGSE-RRT* (Bi-tree Cooperative, Goal-guided, low-discrepancy Sampling, multi-sector Expansion). First, BGSE-RRT* constructs a nonlinear switching probability via bi-tree cooperative adaptive switching, together with KD-Tree nearest-neighbor acceleration and multi-condition triggering, to adaptively balance global exploration and local convergence.

pmc-13450606.title: Associations Between Parenting Stress, Family Support, Emotion Regulation, and Parental Burnout in Parents of Adolescents with Mood Disorders: A Cross-Sectional Structural Equation Modeling and Fuzzy-Set Qualitative Comparative Analysis Study
pmc-13450606.creator: Huili He, Wenwen Lu, Feng Zhang, Lili Ma
pmc-13450606.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). AimParents of adolescents with mood disorders are at high risk of parental burnout. Existing research has examined risk and resource factors in isolation, with limited attention to the role of emotion regulation in relation to parental burnout. The present study integrates the Balance between Risks and Resources Theory and the Emotion Regulation Process Model and aims to examine both the net effects and potential configurations of parental burnout.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted between July and October 2025 using a consecutive sampling strategy.

Previously reported PMG-associated ocular injuries have been limited to unilateral or mild bilateral involvement.
